job.eternalrealm.guardian.desc.ja: 騎士の二次職。盾と挑発で敵を引きつけ、仲間の前に立ち続ける不落の壁。
job.eternalrealm.guardian.desc.en: The knight's second class: shields and provocation, the wall that stands before the party.

job.eternalrealm.paladin.desc.ja: 騎士の二次職。刃に光を宿して戦いながら、加護と癒しで仲間を支える聖なる騎士。
job.eternalrealm.paladin.desc.en: The knight's second class: a holy knight who fights with light on the blade and upholds the party with blessings and healing.

job.eternalrealm.shinobi.desc.ja: 暗殺者の二次職。五遁の忍術・分身・苦無と手裏剣を操り、決して捉えられない影。
job.eternalrealm.shinobi.desc.en: The assassin's second class: elemental ninjutsu, clones, kunai and shuriken; a shadow nobody can catch.

job.eternalrealm.reaper.desc.ja: 暗殺者の二次職。大きく刈り取る斬撃で命を吸い、弱った敵を仕留め、冥府の力で敵を縛る。
job.eternalrealm.reaper.desc.en: The assassin's second class: sweeping reaps that drink life, executions of the weak, and the binding power of the underworld.

job.eternalrealm.sage.desc.ja: 魔導士の二次職。二つの元素を融合させた大魔法と、結界・加速・時の術で仲間を導く。
job.eternalrealm.sage.desc.en: The mage's second class: great spells of fused elements, and barriers, haste and time magic that guide the party.

job.eternalrealm.necromancer.desc.ja: 魔導士の二次職。呪いで敵を蝕み、骨と生命を操り、倒れた仲間さえ蘇らせる。
job.eternalrealm.necromancer.desc.en: The mage's second class: curses that eat at the foe, bone and stolen life, and even the raising of fallen allies.

job.eternalrealm.sniper.desc.ja: 狩人の二次職。溜めた一矢で弱点を射抜き、閃光・煙幕・網の戦術で戦場を支配する。
job.eternalrealm.sniper.desc.en: The ranger's second class: charged shots through the weak point, and flash, smoke and net tactics that rule the field.

job.eternalrealm.spirit_archer.desc.ja: 狩人の二次職。精霊を宿した矢で元素の力を放ち、霊樹の加護で仲間を癒す。
job.eternalrealm.spirit_archer.desc.en: The ranger's second class: arrows that carry the elemental spirits, and the grove's blessing that heals the party.

job.eternalrealm.bishop.desc.ja: 神官の二次職。大いなる癒しと一斉蘇生、光の結界で仲間を守り抜く。
job.eternalrealm.bishop.desc.en: The priest's second class: great heals, mass revival and wards of light that keep the party standing.

job.eternalrealm.inquisitor.desc.ja: 神官の二次職。告発し、縛り、裁く。聖なる炎で悪を焼き払う戦う聖職者。
job.eternalrealm.inquisitor.desc.en: The priest's second class: accuse, bind and judge; a fighting cleric whose holy fire burns evil away.

job.eternalrealm.sword_saint.desc.ja: 魔剣士の二次職。居合・燕返し・千本斬りの極まった剣技と、遠くまで届く剣気。
job.eternalrealm.sword_saint.desc.en: The spellblade's second class: perfected sword technique, and a sword spirit that reaches far beyond the blade.

job.eternalrealm.hexblade.desc.ja: 魔剣士の二次職。血の呪いで傷を力に変え、毒と闇を宿した魔剣を振るう。
job.eternalrealm.hexblade.desc.en: The spellblade's second class: a blood curse that turns wounds into power, and a demon blade of poison and darkness.
